title: Segmentation Metrics: IoU, Dice & Pixel Accuracy
interviewAnswer: Pixel accuracy can be misleading when background dominates. IoU and Dice emphasize overlap between predicted and true masks; per-class metrics reveal minority-structure performance.
keyPoints: Dice is closely related to F1 on pixels.
Boundary metrics can matter for thin structures.
why: Segmentation Metrics: IoU, Dice & Pixel Accuracy is a standard part of a broad data/ML curriculum because it changes how models are selected, evaluated or operated in real systems.
intuition: Dice is closely related to F1 on pixels.
deepDive: Pixel accuracy can be misleading when background dominates. IoU and Dice emphasize overlap between predicted and true masks; per-class metrics reveal minority-structure performance. IoU penalizes union disagreement. Boundary metrics can matter for thin structures. A strong answer connects the formal idea to validation, data requirements and failure modes instead of treating the method as a recipe.
workedExample: A model predicting mostly background may achieve high pixel accuracy but terrible crack/lesion IoU.
commonMistakes: Choosing the technique without checking whether its assumptions match the problem.
Optimizing an offline metric without checking realistic validation slices or operational constraints.

production: In production, validate on realistic slices, track latency/cost when relevant, and monitor for distribution changes or failure modes that the offline metric can hide.
